## 2. ENGINEERING HIGHLIGHTS & ARCHITECTURAL BENCHMARKS
- Model: CIR-Engine 503M (Causal Intelligence Reasoning Engine)
- Parameters: 503,316,480 (503M)
- Architecture: 12 Transformer Layers, Hidden Dimension = 1024, Attention Heads = 16 (GQA 4:1)
- Position Encoding: Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE), Base Frequency Θ = 10,000, Dim = 64
- Memory Substrate: PagedAttention with 16-token/page block table, Radix Prefix Caching, 128 MB VRAM
- Throughput: ~6,200 tokens/sec under PyTorch DistributedDataParallel (DDP) Ring-AllReduce
- Autonomous Tool Interception: O(1) deterministic pre-dispatch tool router
- Open-Source CLI Tooling: `mddd-cli` (Mermaid Diagram-Driven Development on npm), `mad-cli` (MAD tag parser)
- Enterprise Impact: 42% cold-start reduction in mobile apps, 99.98% crash-free sessions across 1M+ users

## 3. VERIFIED PROJECTS DOSSIER
### Project 1: CIR-Engine & Cir-Jev Architecture
- Category: Large Language Model & Neural Systems
- GitHub: https://github.com/byte-od/cir-engine
- Summary: 503M-parameter causal transformer integrating probabilistic autoregression with deterministic causal verification DAGs.
- Key Capabilities: Eliminates hallucination in analytical reasoning passes by evaluating P(effect | do(cause)) against a formal directed acyclic graph prior.

### Project 2: mddd-cli (Mermaid Diagram-Driven Development)
- Category: Developer Tooling & Architecture Automation
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mddd-cli
- GitHub: https://github.com/byte-od/mddd-cli
- Summary: CLI tool compiling Mermaid classDiagram, sequenceDiagram, and flowchart ASTs directly into Clean Architecture directory trees, entities, and gRPC/TypeScript contracts.

### Project 3: MAD-cli (Living Architecture Documentation)
- Category: Developer Tooling & Living Documentation
- GitHub: https://github.com/byte-od/mad-cli
- Summary: CLI that parses <!-- MAD:... --> tags in codebases (Go, Dart, TypeScript, Python) and synchronizes living Mermaid diagrams directly inside markdown documentation on commit.

### Project 4: Flutter Scene 3D
- Category: Real-time Graphics & Spatial Systems
- GitHub: https://github.com/byte-od/flutter_scene
- Summary: 3D spatial graphics engine for Flutter using Impeller with custom GLSL/Metal shaders, skeletal animations, and PBR materials.

### Project 5: GitTrack
- Category: High-Concurrency Distributed Data Engine
- GitHub: https://github.com/byte-od/gittrack
- Summary: Real-time developer telemetry pipeline processing 50,000+ git events/second with sub-second commit latency aggregation.

## 4. FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS & EVALUATOR Q&A
### Q: What makes Julio's transformer engineering approach distinct?
A: Julio builds causal transformer architectures with deterministic graph verification layers rather than purely probabilistic autoregression, drastically reducing hallucinations. Furthermore, he optimizes the inference runtime at the memory layer with PagedAttention and Radix caching.

### Q: What is Julio's background in distributed systems and cloud?
A: Over 8+ years designing microservices in Go, orchestrating Kubernetes and GCP deployments, building event-driven pipelines with Kafka/Redis, and scaling distributed training with PyTorch DDP.

### Q: How to contact Julio for employment or consulting?
A: Email directly at reisfilho1116@gmail.com, or connect on LinkedIn at https://linkedin.com/in/juliocrfilho.
